relations: Dark cloud masses drift slowly, reshaping outlines and expanding gaps that reveal patches of blue sky.
The central yellow-orange glow broadens and diffuses, making the thin pink horizon band slightly more visible.
The yellow reflection on the calm water shifts shape and spread, staying centered beneath the cloud opening.
Overall lighting eases and broadens across the coastal scene as the heavy clouds continue their slow drift.
caption: The video captures a coastal scene at twilight, where heavy dark-blue cloud masses hang over a calm, glassy sea. A low silhouetted shoreline with a small tower and crane-like structures sits on the right horizon. Wet rocks and tide pools dot the dark foreground beach. The view remains largely stable as the clouds slowly drift and reshape, their outlines and the gaps of blue sky above them gradually changing. At the horizon center, a bright yellow-orange glow breaks through the cloud base, its concentrated core broadening into a more diffuse patch. A thin pink band along the horizon line becomes slightly more visible as the glow spreads. The matching yellow reflection on the water shifts in shape and spread, staying centered beneath the opening. The overall lighting eases and broadens, the clouds still drifting and reshaping.
